description_en: Queries the list of sound code labels for a specified schedule
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定排程的声码标签列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot query-sound-code-label-list --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --schedule-code Md3ZiTL888K9llXDy789000000000000 --page-size 20 --page-id 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QuerySoundCodeLabelList
